import Route types.description:
**Framework mode.** Generated per-route types. Run `react-router typegen` (or start the dev server) to produce `./+types/<route>`.
The file name must match the route module's own file name.

Route.ComponentProps.description: **Framework mode.** Props the route's default export receives. Everything is typed from this route's own loader and action.

Route.LoaderArgs.description:
**Framework mode.** Arguments to a server `loader`. `params` is typed from the route's path segments.
`url` is the normalized `URL`; `pattern` holds the un-interpolated route pattern.

Route.ClientLoaderArgs.description: **Framework mode.** Arguments to a `clientLoader`. `serverLoader()` fetches this route's server loader data.

Route.ActionArgs.description: **Framework mode.** Arguments to a server `action`. Read the submission with `await request.formData()`.

Route.ClientActionArgs.description: **Framework mode.** Arguments to a `clientAction`. `serverAction()` delegates to this route's server action.

Route.MetaArgs.description: **Framework mode.** Arguments to `meta`. Use `loaderData` — the `data` field was removed in v8.

Route.ErrorBoundaryProps.description: **Framework mode.** Props an `ErrorBoundary` export receives. `error` is `unknown` — narrow it with `isRouteErrorResponse`.
